This type of '''gun platform''' was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One such platform was commanded by the [[Cyborg Separatist commander]] during the [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|battle of unidentified planet]] where it was destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who sliced it in half with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
